notes.title: Major Update: Version 1.1, 28 new extremely difficult levels and UX update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, thank you for your support! We have currently sold about 100 copies of the game. This update will bring you 4 extremely difficult levels for each world, totaling 28 levels, along with UX updates.[/p][p]You can now see purple special levels on the map. Each map has 4 special levels, which will appear once the area is completed to a certain extent. The difficulty of the special levels will be extremely high, and it's estimated that each level after the third map will take about 8 minutes on average.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/c5709400fdb31688d34e96276542ebcd057b594c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/028291cfed8365fd68b533f8c6748876a7091f4a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]UX Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]When the mouse hovers over a house for a while, it will now show the connectable segments for that house, and the segments that are already connected will change color.[/p][/*][*][p]When the mouse hovers over a portal for a while, it will not only show the connectable segments but also change the segments connected to that portal to blue, while the segments connected to the exit portal will turn green. Segments that are not connected to the entry or exit portals will remain black.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/3c0fb9b388a883933206d8922220ff3c914041e7.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix and small update
notes.content:
Bug Fix:
Ensure that the next level can be generated correctly.

Minor Updates:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/1043e26fbf48fe8ef757a8ffae540847c8b346a7.png[/img]
When the power supply of the house equals the required power, the number in the upper right corner will turn green.

A sound effect will play when the mouse hovers over the house.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/dea4a219397cf98d13723d5e7d8c9485fffbbd19.png[/img]
A display showing the number of connected units has been added to the upper right corner of the tunnel.

notes.title: Major update to the demo version!!
notes.content:
The playtest version has been updated!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/3fe5316c952a0f8c438b806c0ec576c208afc7d0.png[/img]
Update Details:
Scene Update: The game scenes are now represented in a blueprint format, providing a warmer feel and making game items easier to access.
House Number Display: In addition to the required power in the center, the number of connected items will now be displayed in the top right corner.
Adjusted Difficulty Curve: The difficulty of the levels has been smoothed out for a better experience.
Current Levels: The playtest version now includes 30 levels, with 2 different special items available.
New Buttons:
R: Remove all lines
Z: Undo the last action
X: Redo the next action
hope you enjoy playing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/2683d81f919962df4c32699cfbe5a5d4ca2825dc.png[/img]
